title: FatturaPA: the Italian e-invoice the Sistema di Interscambio takes
source: Schema 1.2.3 (Schema_VFPR12_v1.2.3.xsd, one file for FPR12 and FPA12, SHA-256 152944f6eef9) and the technical specifications 1.4, valid from 1 April 2025. Invoices between parties resident or established in Italy are issued only as e-invoices through the Sistema di Interscambio in this format (D.Lgs. 127/2015 art. 1 comma 3; from 1 January 2027 art. 77 of the Testo unico IVA). FPR12 goes to a private party, FPA12 to a public body; TD01 is an invoice, TD04 a credit note. The library writes the file and sends nothing: the page beside it is a courtesy copy. Read 2026-10-09.

rules.text: The FatturaPA schema 1.2.3 accepts the Italian invoice or credit note beside the page; skipped when it is not installed. The file is not sent to the Sistema di Interscambio, and the rule's evidence says so.
